record_body:
Company summary:
- NorthBridge Cloud Advisors is a cloud consulting/SI firm (partner-like) that implements LLM features for mid-market + enterprise customers.
- They want a formal referral / co-sell motion with Redwood Inference, explicitly tied to AWS + GCP Marketplace procurement (customers prefer marketplace for committed spend, invoicing, vendor onboarding).

What they asked for (highlights):
- “We want to standardize on Redwood for inference for a subset of our GenAI builds, but our clients increasingly insist on buying through AWS/GCP Marketplace.”
- Referral structure: they want credit/fee when (a) they source an opportunity OR (b) they influence architecture and the customer purchases via marketplace.
- Operationally: they want a lightweight intake + tracking process (so deals don’t get lost when a customer goes self-serve on marketplace).
- Want Redwood guidance on which SKU to start with for typical workloads (Hosted API first, then Dedicated / Private as needed).

Use cases they see across their client base:
- RAG / doc search for internal knowledge bases (embeddings + reranking; latency sensitive for interactive apps).
- Summarization pipelines for tickets/calls (throughput sensitive; cost per token focus).
- Support-agent copilots (needs streaming + reliability; occasional PII).
- Some regulated clients asking for VPC/private deployment and explicit audit logging + retention controls.

Marketplace-specific requirements / questions:
- How marketplace purchase maps to Redwood orgs and entitlements (multi-account clients; parent/child org complexity).
- Whether they can structure private offers / negotiated terms for larger clients while still using marketplace.
- How to represent add-ons (retention, premium SLA, compliance packages) without confusing procurement.
- Attribution: they want partner tracking (UTMs, partner code, or “referred by” field) to survive marketplace flow.

Security/compliance notes (from partner + their typical client questionnaires):
- They repeatedly asked for crisp statements on SOC 2 posture, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, audit logging, and data residency.
- They want a shareable, customer-facing marketplace security FAQ they can forward during procurement.
- They asked for “no overpromises” language they can copy/paste into client security forms.

Activity timeline (recent):
- 2025-11-18: Inbound via partner form (NorthBridge) asking about referral motion + AWS Marketplace availability.
- 2025-12-02: Intro call w/ Markus Klein (SE) + Jordan Blake; partner described 3 near-term clients likely to procure via marketplace (2 AWS, 1 GCP).
- 2025-12-09: Sent partner the draft customer marketplace FAQ + internal training slides (request: make a partner-safe version).
- 2026-01-07: Follow-up: partner asked about private offers + how to handle add-ons (retention/compliance) in marketplace terms.
- 2026-02-14: Partner requested a single-page “How to buy Redwood via marketplace (for procurement)” they can brand into their project plans; also asked for a deal registration process.

Internal notes / guidance (not customer-facing):
- This is not a pure end-customer account; treat as channel/partner-like. However, near-term pipeline depends on how cleanly marketplace onboarding works (purchase → entitlement → org linking).
- Risk: if NorthBridge pushes clients to marketplace before entitlement mapping/onboarding is stable, support load increases and partner experience degrades.

Next steps (proposed):
- Define minimal partner referral workflow: deal registration form + unique partner identifier captured prior to marketplace purchase.
- Align internally w/ Finance/Legal on whether marketplace-sourced spend can carry referral fees and how to calculate (given marketplace fee/revrec constraints).
- Provide a partner-safe bundle: (1) customer FAQ link, (2) SKU selection cheat sheet, (3) procurement checklist + “what info we need to activate entitlements quickly.”

Open questions:
- Can we support partner attribution end-to-end when the customer starts in marketplace (vs Redwood first)?
- For GCP Marketplace: partner asked if we can simplify SKU taxonomy for their clients (bundle vs split). Pending PM decision.

Call references / artifacts:
- Fireflies: ff-9057 (used as a reference for common marketplace procurement questions and talk track; needs partner-safe excerpt).
- Gmail: thread-44a9117e (tracking/attribution discussion; UTMs + lead routing).
- Drive: marketplace SKU mapping sheet + customer FAQ draft (paths linked in record).
